title: Symmetry under simultaneous negation
statement: Let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the probability distribution obtained from independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ by setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$. The distribution of $(-X,-Y)$ equals the distribution of $(X,Y)$.
